errors.network: The server is not answering. Check the connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: The server refused: your role does not cover this object.
errors.unexpected: The server refused the request. Status {{status}}.

refusal.title: The request was refused

blockedBy.rooms_one: {{count, number}} room is attached to this dormitory.
blockedBy.rooms_other: {{count, number}} rooms are attached to this dormitory.

refusal.blockedWayOut: Move or delete the rooms first — or archive the dormitory instead, and the residency history stays readable.
refusal.conflictWhere: Room {{room}}, place {{bed}}, contract {{contract}}. Record the move-out first.
refusal.conflictAnonymous: a resident the answer did not name
refusal.conflictUnknown: The server refused but attached no conflicting record.
refusal.validationTitle: The form is filled in incorrectly
refusal.serverFault: The server failed to process the request. Its own message is withheld here: a fault is not a refusal, and its text is for the log, not for the screen.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Accounts are issued by the dormitory administration.
login.invalid: The email or the password is wrong.
login.attemptsLeft_one: {{count}} attempt left before sign-in is blocked.
login.attemptsLeft_other: {{count}} attempts left before sign-in is blocked.
login.lastAttemptUsed: That was the last attempt: sign-in for this email is closed.
login.lockedBody: Five failed attempts close sign-in for this email. You can try again in {{remaining}}.
login.lockedOver: The block has expired, try signing in again.
login.throttledBody: Too many requests have come from this device in a row and the server stopped taking them. You can try again in {{remaining}}.
login.throttledBodySoon: Too many requests have come from this device in a row and the server stopped taking them. Try again shortly.

validation.email: Enter an email in the form name@example.com.
validation.other: The field “{{field}}” is filled in incorrectly.

login.sessionExpired: The session ended. Sign in again.
login.note: The token is kept until the tab is closed, so a session does not outlive a shift on the shared computer at the security post.

register.heading: Register of dormitories
register.leadAdmin: Creating, editing, archiving and deleting belong to the administrator. The server takes the decision: a request from another role is refused.
register.leadScoped: The dormitories your account is attached to. The server narrows the list.
register.empty: No dormitory is visible to you. If that is wrong, ask the administrator.

building.heading: Building card
building.visitingNote: The visiting window is the span in which a guest may stay in the building in the presence of the resident who invited them.

rooms.heading: Rooms and places
rooms.lead: Capacity is the ceiling the warden registers places up to. The free remainder and the vacancies are two different figures, and both are named below.
rooms.empty: This dormitory has no rooms yet.
rooms.remainder_one: {{count, number}} more place may be registered
rooms.remainder_other: {{count, number}} more places may be registered
rooms.numberNote: Unique inside the dormitory. Usually the floor and two digits: 305 is room 5 on the third floor.
rooms.capacityNote: How many places the room may hold. Lowering it below the places already registered is refused by the server.
rooms.statusNote: A room that is not in service takes no new residents, however many of its places are empty.

places.none: The room holds no places yet.
places.label: Place {{label}}
places.remainder_one: {{count, number}} place short of the capacity of {{capacity}}.
places.remainder_other: {{count, number}} places short of the capacity of {{capacity}}.
places.unnamed: Name not read: the resident card is not available
places.roomClosedNote: The room is not in service

residency.noCandidates: The roll of this dormitory lists no residents. An account for an incoming resident is issued by the administrator in this version.
residency.candidateNote: The choice is limited to people already attached to this dormitory: this version of the contract has no route for creating a resident account.
residency.groundNote: The ground is recorded verbatim: an order number, a decision of the committee.
residency.assignSummary: To be recorded: room {{room}}, place {{bed}}, from {{date}}
residency.releaseGroundNote: Without a ground the server refuses. It is recorded verbatim — for instance, “graduation, art. 105 cl. 2 of the Housing Code”.
residency.releaseDateNote: The place is free at once. The resident's access to building-bound functions ends on the stated date, which may be set forward.
residency.unknownRecord: The residency record has not been read, so the move-out cannot be filed. Open the resident card instead.

plan.heading: Floor plan
plan.notAPlan: This is not a drawing of the premises. The data holds a floor number and a room number and nothing about where the doors are, so the rooms are laid out as a grid per floor rather than as a layout.
plan.namesFromCards: The names come from the resident cards of this dormitory. Every card read is written to the audit log — it is a read of personal data.
plan.namesWithheld: Resident names are not shown: the cards are closed to your role in this dormitory.
plan.cardsRefused_one: The server refused {{count, number}} card — that place is left unnamed.
plan.cardsRefused_other: The server refused {{count, number}} cards — those places are left unnamed.

resident.heading: Resident card
resident.auditNote: The card carries personal data, so reading it is written to the audit log.
resident.noPlace: Holds no place at the moment.
resident.obligationsNote: In this version the register knows one kind of obligation — an accommodation contract that has not been terminated. Obligations arising from the inventory handover come later.

people.heading: People of the building
people.empty: Nobody is listed in this building yet.
people.hint: The roll is open to the administrator and to the warden, manager or duty officer of this building. Other roles are refused by the server.

audit.heading: Audit log
audit.lead: Entries are written by the server and cannot be edited. Reading the log is itself logged.
